title: Lookbook de Moda en Cuadrícula: 9 Poses Dinámicas de una Modelo en Cielo Azul
prompt: A high-resolution 3x3 grid photo collage featuring 9 different dynamic poses of a female model, set against a vibrant blue sky dotted with white clouds. Strong, natural sunlight creates clear, sharp shadows. The model wears a knit sweater paired with a skirt and a thin silver necklace. Photography utilizes various focal lengths, transitioning freely from 35mm wide-angle full-body shots to 85mm close-up portraits. Poses are diverse and rich, including: a powerful stance with legs apart and hands behind head; a perspective shot with palm pointing directly at the camera; a playful close-up peering through an OK hand gesture over one eye; a cheerful mid-shot with chin resting in hands; and a melancholic pose with one hand covering half the face. Image quality is 8K resolution, presenting ultra-realistic effects, showcasing delicate skin texture, subsurface scattering, realistic clothing folds, and distinct hair strands, embodying the refined aesthetic of a high-end commercial fashion lookbook or lifestyle campaign. Background is the Southern Alps of New Zealand. --ar 3:4
